subject: risk block issue + also a question about faster settlement
body:
Following up again on the international RISK_BLOCK problem I raised earlier this week - still happening, still losing sales, please look into it.

Separate question while I have you - we've been on the platform well over a year now with no disputes that I'm aware of. Are we eligible for T+1 settlement? Nobody's ever mentioned it to us and I'd like to apply if we qualify.
